name: odontogram-workspace
description: Bun workspace for the Cognovis odontogram: the published chart SDK, the Aidbox transport package, and the standalone app that consumes both.

scripts.build: bun run build:lib && bun run --filter @cognovis/odontogram-standalone build
scripts.build:lib: bun run --filter @cognovis/react-odontogram build:lib && bun run --filter @cognovis/react-odontogram-fhir build:lib
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/odontogram --noEmit && tsc -p packages/odontogram-fhir --noEmit && tsc -p apps/standalone --noEmit
